help.ai.chat.title: 💬 Let's Chat!
help.ai.chat.value: Just @mention me! I know the context of our conversation and what server we are on.
help.ai.description: I'm not just a bot, I actually understand you.
help.ai.memory.title: 🎯 Smart Memory
help.ai.memory.value: If you allow it in `/privacy`, I can remember our voice times, what games you play, and your Spotify tracks.
help.ai.title: 🤖 My AI Brain
help.ai.toggle.title: ⚙️ Toggleable
help.ai.toggle.value: Admins can turn my AI brain on or off in the server settings.
help.ai.web.title: 🌐 Internet Access
help.ai.web.value: If I don't know something, I can search the web and bring you fresh info.
help.economy.balance.title: **/profile**
help.economy.balance.value: Check your global wallet and store money safely in the vault. (on website looks better)
help.economy.description: Earn, spend, and manage your global balance!
help.economy.leaderboard.title: **/leaderboard**
help.economy.leaderboard.value: See who is the richest around here. (Requires 'publicity' enabled in /privacy!)
help.economy.tip.title: 💡 Pro Tip
help.economy.tip.value: Use `/upgrade`(sorry, disabled) to boost your work multiplier. It stacks with boosts!
help.economy.title: 💰 My Economy
help.economy.transfer.title: **/transfer(future)**
help.economy.transfer.value: Send money to your friends across any server.
help.economy.work.title: **/work & /rob(future)**
help.economy.work.value: Earn €50-150 every 30 mins, or try to steal from others (if you dare!).
help.faq.ai.title: 🤖 I'm ignoring you?
help.faq.ai.value: You MUST @mention me to trigger my AI! If I'm still quiet, my neural networks might be overloaded right now.
help.faq.codes.title: 🌐 Weird codes instead of text?
help.faq.codes.value: That's a glitch in my translation matrix! Report it on my official server (maybe you'll get a reward 😏).
help.faq.cooldown.title: ⏳ Stuck on 'Waiting'?
help.faq.cooldown.value: There is a global 10-second anti-spam delay between all commands. `/work` has a 30m delay.
help.faq.description: What to do when things go wrong.
help.faq.errors.title: 🚨 An error popped up?
help.faq.errors.value: Don't panic! If I replied that an error occurred, I've already sent the logs to my creators. Just wait a bit!
help.faq.permissions.title: ❌ Can't kick/ban someone?
help.faq.permissions.value: My role MUST be higher than the person you are trying to punish. I also can't punish the server owner!
help.faq.title: 🛠️ FAQ & Troubleshooting
help.footer: ✨ Use `/help` for the full command list.
help.mod.automod.title: 🤖 AutoMod AI
help.mod.automod.value: I can protect your chat! Set up rules, and my AI will delete bad messages and suggest actions in logs.
help.mod.chat_magic.title: 🪄 Chat Magic
help.mod.chat_magic.value: Don't want to use slash commands? Just @mention me and ask to mute someone or change a setting in plain English!
help.mod.core.title: 🔨 Moderation Core
help.mod.description: Full server control and smart moderation for admins.
help.mod.reports.title: 🚨 Quick Reports
help.mod.reports.value: Users can right-click a message or user to report them straight to you and my creators.
help.mod.settings.title: 🔧 /settings
help.mod.settings.value: Configure log channels, bot update filters, chat mini-games (words, numbers), and set message TTL per channel.
help.mod.title: ⚙️ Admin & Settings
help.privacy.default.title: 🛡️ Default behavior
help.privacy.default.value: I don’t collect much by default. Even if I could — I won’t unless you explicitly allow it.
help.privacy.description: Yes, this is the place where you decide if I’m allowed to know anything about you.
help.privacy.enabled.title: 👀 What can be enabled
help.privacy.enabled.value: Activity tracking, voice time, messages, favorite commands. Yes, I turn it into graphs. Pretty ones. Slightly scary ones.
help.privacy.note.title: 😏 Important note
help.privacy.note.value: If you don’t enable analytics, I literally know almost nothing about you. Kind of awkward, honestly.
help.privacy.panel.title: ⚙️ Control panel
help.privacy.panel.value: Use /privacy or visit the website. Yes, the website is basically my real brain — Discord is just the interface.
help.privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy Control Center
help.social.fun.title: 🎉 Fun Stuff
help.social.fun.value: Unlock `/achievements` (soon), check world `/holiday`, or use `/format_numbers` to change how I show big numbers.
help.social.graphs.title: 📈 Activity Graphs
help.social.graphs.value: Type `/graph` or visit my website to see detailed charts of your activity (if tracking is enabled).
help.social.link.title: 🔗 Link Checker
help.social.link.value: Got a sus link? Use `/link` and I'll show you its redirect tree and the final destination.
help.social.profile.title: 👤 Profiles & XP
help.social.profile.value: Use `/profile` or `/leaderboards` to view global stats. Earn XP just by chatting in text or voice!
help.social.title: 🧰 Social & Utilities
help.social.translator.title: 🌍 Built-in Translator
help.social.translator.value: I speak 25 languages! Add me to your account, right-click any message -> Apps -> 'Translate Message'.
help.start.activation.title: 🚀 Activation
help.start.activation.value: No registration required! I create your profile the moment you use your first command.
help.start.language.title: 🌐 Language
help.start.language.value: I adapt to your Discord client language. Want to force a different one? Use `/language`.
help.start.learn_more.title: 📖 Learn More
help.start.learn_more.value: Type `/help` to see my full list of tricks!
help.start.logs.title: ⚙️ Setup Logs
help.start.logs.value: Admins, set a log channel using `/configure log_channel #channel`.
help.start.permissions.title: ✅ Permissions
help.start.permissions.value: Make sure my role is high up in the server settings so I can moderate properly.
help.start.title: 📚 Getting Started

welcome.description:
I’m not here to convince you I’m essential.
By default, I barely collect anything — yes, I’m that ‘privacy-first bot with attitude’.

If you ever want analytics, stats, or fancy graphs — you decide when (or if) that happens.
welcome.feature_1: 📊 Clean analytics from Discord activity (finally usable data, not chaos)
welcome.feature_2: 🔒 Full privacy control — I do nothing unless you allow it
welcome.feature_3: 🌐 Everything important lives on the website, not inside Discord spam commands
welcome.feature_4: 🤖 Optional AI layer — only if you enable it (I’m not freeloading your data)
